services.name: OCode.js Documentation Site
services.healthSemantics: Static GitHub Pages site; no application health endpoint. GitHub Actions verifies HTTP responses for / and /infra/ and parses the service registry after deployment.
services.authentication: Public read-only documentation; no user session is required.
evidence: GitHub Pages deployment completed successfully on main commit 6b970016bdda478099f8702a268f91b8bbf3f468 in workflow run 41307329427 (run #121).
Post-deployment smoke test in run #121 successfully fetched /, /infra/, and /ecosystem/services.json; the JSON parser confirmed services is an array.

On main commit 084a61ebb3f3c3e667c4f589f4e82ec7a62d238f, Pages deployment and all static HTTP checks passed in workflow run 41308066253; the overall job failed only in the separate MCP smoke-test step before that check was isolated.
Verified public URL from the Pages deployment output: https://zskbot.github.io/docs-ocodejs/.
services.notes: Public URL and static HTTP smoke tests are verified; Pages deployment is now independent of MCP availability and revalidated after each main deployment.

services.name: OCode.js Documentation MCP
services.healthSemantics: The Worker deployment is present, but unauthenticated HTTP access to /health currently returns HTTP 403 from the Cloudflare edge. An account-level All Workers Access application exists, but the exact blocking rule has not been confirmed.
services.authentication: Cloudflare Access Service Token is required for automated CI access; the public documentation API is read-only and does not use a GitHub write token.
evidence: Worker source and wrangler.toml are present in the repository.
Cloudflare Worker deployment and scoped Cloudflare Access Service Auth policy were verified during the 2026-11-01 infrastructure review.
GitHub Actions Documentation MCP smoke test passed on main commit 488bab237f54d28ef8e967195830cdb8782535b3 in workflow run 41314605189.
The smoke test passed the Access service-token preflight, GET /health, MCP initialize handshake, and tools/list request.
The same MCP smoke test passed on the preceding main commit aca5fe65e95fcb132f7fd85f633305be2ff9a9d4 in workflow run 41313908839.
services.notes: Authenticated CI runtime verification is green. Requests without the scoped Cloudflare Access service token may receive HTTP 403 by design; do not classify that response as an outage. Keep the service token in GitHub Actions secrets only and never publish its values.
